import sys
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def main():
    path = sys.argv[1]
    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    facts = []

    # ---- Totals ----
    rev_tw = df['Revenue_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df['Revenue_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_ly = df['Revenue_LY'].sum(skipna=True)
    units_tw = df['Units_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
    units_lw = df['Units_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
    orders_tw = df['Orders_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
    orders_lw = df['Orders_LW'].sum(skipna=True)

    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "TW",
                  "value": round(float(rev_tw), 2), "formula": "sum(Revenue_TW)"})
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "LW",
                  "value": round(float(rev_lw), 2), "formula": "sum(Revenue_LW)"})
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "LY",
                  "value": round(float(rev_ly), 2), "formula": "sum(Revenue_LY)"})
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "units", "period": "TW",
                  "value": round(float(units_tw), 2), "formula": "sum(Units_TW)"})
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "units", "period": "LW",
                  "value": round(float(units_lw), 2), "formula": "sum(Units_LW)"})
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "orders", "period": "TW",
                  "value": round(float(orders_tw), 2), "formula": "sum(Orders_TW)"})
    facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "orders", "period": "LW",
                  "value": round(float(orders_lw), 2), "formula": "sum(Orders_LW)"})

    if rev_lw and not pd.isna(rev_lw) and rev_lw != 0:
        wow_total = (rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100
        facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "WoW",
                      "value": round(float(wow_total), 1),
                      "formula": "(sum(Revenue_TW)-sum(Revenue_LW))/sum(Revenue_LW)*100"})

    if rev_ly and not pd.isna(rev_ly) and rev_ly != 0:
        yoy_total = (rev_tw - rev_ly) / rev_ly * 100
        facts.append({"entity": "TOTAL", "metric": "revenue", "period": "YoY",
                      "value": round(float(yoy_total), 1),
                      "formula": "(sum(Revenue_TW)-sum(Revenue_LY))/sum(Revenue_LY)*100"})

    # ---- Top 3 entities by this week's revenue ----
    top3 = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue_TW']).sort_values('Revenue_TW', ascending=False).head(3)
    for _, row in top3.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric": "revenue", "period": "TW",
                      "value": round(float(row['Revenue_TW']), 2), "formula": "Revenue_TW"})
        if 'Share_Pct' in df.columns and not pd.isna(row.get('Share_Pct', np.nan)):
            facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric": "share", "period": "TW",
                          "value": round(float(row['Share_Pct']), 1), "formula": "Share_Pct"})

    # ---- Top 3 WoW gainers / decliners ----
    wow_valid = df.dropna(subset=['WoW_Pct'])
    gainers = wow_valid.sort_values('WoW_Pct', ascending=False).head(3)
    decliners = wow_valid.sort_values('WoW_Pct', ascending=True).head(3)
    for _, row in gainers.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric": "revenue", "period": "WoW",
                      "value": round(float(row['WoW_Pct']), 1),
                      "formula": "(Revenue_TW-Revenue_LW)/Revenue_LW*100"})
    for _, row in decliners.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric": "revenue", "period": "WoW",
                      "value": round(float(row['WoW_Pct']), 1),
                      "formula": "(Revenue_TW-Revenue_LW)/Revenue_LW*100"})

    # ---- Top 2 YoY gainers / decliners ----
    yoy_valid = df.dropna(subset=['YoY_Pct'])
    yoy_gainers = yoy_valid.sort_values('YoY_Pct', ascending=False).head(2)
    yoy_decliners = yoy_valid.sort_values('YoY_Pct', ascending=True).head(2)
    for _, row in yoy_gainers.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric": "revenue", "period": "YoY",
                      "value": round(float(row['YoY_Pct']), 1),
                      "formula": "(Revenue_TW-Revenue_LY)/Revenue_LY*100"})
    for _, row in yoy_decliners.iterrows():
        facts.append({"entity": row['Entity'], "metric": "revenue", "period": "YoY",
                      "value": round(float(row['YoY_Pct']), 1),
                      "formula": "(Revenue_TW-Revenue_LY)/Revenue_LY*100"})

    facts = facts[:25]

    print(json.dumps(facts))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
